transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. How can I help you today?

I'm here because... well, I just have this restless feeling a lot of the time. It's like I'm wound too tight. I can't seem to just settle down, even when I'm trying to do quiet things like yoga, or painting, or sitting in a planning meeting for work. I just... can't settle.
Can you tell me more about this restless feeling? Do you feel this way all the time, even when you're by yourself, or does it seem to come and go depending on the situation?

I suppose it's... pretty constant. Even on the weekends. I just tend to finish one thing and immediately start another. Like... laundry, or checking emails, reorganizing some product samples for work... maybe touching up a painting. My husband says I never really power down. So... yeah, I guess it's all the time.
Do you find yourself moving around a lot, like fidgeting, pacing, or feeling like you can't sit still for very long?

I suppose so, yeah. Um... like when I'm on calls with suppliers, my foot is usually bouncing under the desk. And I... I tend to click a pen or twist my ring a lot. I actually have to mute myself sometimes so they don't hear the clicking, or... or just make sure my hands are out of view on the camera. But I guess that's about it.

Do you find yourself worrying a lot about different things, even when there isn’t an immediate problem? Like, do you often feel anxious about work, relationships, or other responsibilities, even if everything seems okay on the surface?

Um... no, not really. I mean, I have normal stress with work, I guess, but... I wouldn't say I sit around worrying about things. If there's no actual problem, I'm... I'm not really anxious about it. I just prefer to keep busy.
Have you noticed any days where you feel down or lose interest in things you usually enjoy, even for a little while?
No, not really. I mean... I have my days, like anyone else, but I don't think I really get down like that. I still enjoy my hobbies and everything.
Do you ever find it hard to focus or stay concentrated on tasks, even when you're trying your best to pay attention?
Um... no, not really. I mean, if I need to pay attention to something, I can. I might be tapping my foot like I said before, but... my focus is fine. I don't really struggle with that.
Do you ever notice tightness in your muscles, like your shoulders or neck feeling tense, or find it hard to relax even when you're not actively doing something?
No, not really. I mean... my muscles feel fine. I don't really get tense like that.
Do you ever feel an inner sense of restlessness that makes it hard for you to stay still, even if you're not trying to focus or be productive?

Um... yes. I suppose that's actually why I made the appointment. I just have this... constant restless feeling. Like I'm wound a bit too tight. I can't really fully settle down. Even when I'm supposed to just be sitting calmly, like in a planning meeting for work... or if I'm painting, or trying to do yoga. It's just hard to settle.
Do you ever find that your mind tends to wander or that you get distracted easily, even when you're trying to focus on something important?
No, not really. I mean, my focus is generally fine. I don't really have a problem with my mind wandering.
Do you often find yourself talking more than usual, especially in situations where people might expect you to be quiet, like meetings or during downtime?
No... I don't think so. I'm not really much of a talker. I mostly just keep to myself in those kinds of situations.
